title: Wheat and Branches
originalTitle: Wheat Field with Cypresses × Première Arabesque

facts.text: Van Gogh painted this oil study in 1889; the Met distinguishes it from two later studio versions.
Debussy’s Arabesque No. 1 is performed on piano by Patrizia Prati in this recording.

note: The cypresses lead the eye upward; the wheat brings it back across the canvas. I chose Debussy’s Arabesque for the connection between musical ornament and these branching shapes. The picture gives that abstract title somewhere to wander.

zh-CN.title: 麦浪与枝条
facts: 梵高于1889年创作这幅油画写生；大都会将它与后来两幅画室版本区分。
这份录音由Patrizia Prati以钢琴演奏德彪西《第一号阿拉伯风格曲》。
zh-CN.note: 柏树把视线往上引，麦田又将它带回画面。选择德彪西的《阿拉伯风格曲》，是因为音乐装饰与这些分岔形状之间的关联。画面给这个抽象曲名一处可以游走的地方。

title: At the Near Bank
originalTitle: 조어산수도 [釣漁山水圖] × 流水

facts.text: This Joseon hanging scroll, dated to the 1600s, is attributed to Yi Bul-hae; it uses ink and slight color on silk.
Charlie Huang recorded the Sichuan-style guqin piece Liu Shui in Birmingham on 15 April 2006.

note: The small boat is a useful place to begin. Beside Flowing Water, the fisherman makes water into somewhere a person can spend an afternoon; reeds, rocks and the far bank gradually become a route out from that seat.

zh-CN.title: 近岸
facts: 这幅朝鲜王朝立轴定年为17世纪，归于李不害名下，以绢本水墨淡彩绘制。
Charlie Huang于2006年4月15日在伯明翰录制这首川派古琴曲《流水》。
zh-CN.note: 从小舟看起很合适。在《流水》旁，渔夫让水成为一个人可以度过下午的地方；芦苇、石头和对岸，渐渐构成从那个座位向外延伸的路线。

title: Bamboo Beside a Rock
originalTitle: Bamboo in the Wind × 陽關三疊

facts.text: Ma Yu made Bamboo in the Wind in 1724, using ink on silk.
This recording of Yangguan Sandie is performed on guqin by Charlie Huang (Charles R Tsua).

note: Bamboo bends around something that stays put. Yangguan Sandie brings a farewell into that arrangement: a person leaves, a place remains. That is the association I want to leave beside Ma Yu’s rock and leaves.

zh-CN.title: 石边竹
facts: 马豫于1724年创作《Bamboo in the Wind》，媒材为绢本水墨。
这份《阳关三叠》录音由Charlie Huang（Charles R Tsua）以古琴演奏。
zh-CN.note: 竹子在不动的石头旁弯折。《阳关三叠》把送别带进这个关系：人会离开，地方留下。这是我想放在马豫的石与叶旁的一层联想。

title: One Swaying Leaf
originalTitle: Gilded Dish with Flowers and Leaves × Recuerdos de la Alhambra

facts.text: This Iznik dish dates to about 1590. Its decoration includes a central saz leaf and surviving gilding.
Carlo Alberto Boni performs Francisco Tárrega’s Recuerdos de la Alhambra on guitar in this recording.

note: One leaf divides the dish, while smaller flowers make the journey around it more involved. I chose the guitar’s Alhambra remembrance for this meeting of ornament and recollection: an everyday object becomes a place to revisit.

zh-CN.title: 一片摆动的叶
facts: 这件伊兹尼克盘约制于1590年，装饰包含居中的saz叶形及留存的描金。
这份录音由Carlo Alberto Boni以吉他演奏弗朗西斯科·塔雷加《阿尔罕布拉宫的回忆》。
zh-CN.note: 一片叶形分开盘面，小花让环绕观看的路线更加曲折。选择吉他的《阿尔罕布拉宫的回忆》，是想让装饰与回忆相遇：日常器物也可以成为反复回访的地方。

title: Cranes Around a Vase
originalTitle: 청자 상감 운학무늬 매병 [靑磁象嵌雲鶴文梅甁] × Gymnopédie No. 3

facts.text: This Korean Goryeo celadon vase dates to the 1300s and uses inlaid white and black slip decoration.
David Hernando Vitores’s recording arranges Satie’s Gymnopédie No. 3 for soprano saxophone and strings.

note: Clay carries the cranes around a curved surface. Satie’s composition, carried here by soprano saxophone and strings, offers another change of material. The pairing keeps the birds in flight while the vessel stays perfectly still.

zh-CN.title: 绕瓶而飞
facts: 这件韩国高丽青瓷瓶定年为14世纪，使用白、黑化妆土镶嵌装饰。
David Hernando Vitores的这份录音将萨蒂《第三号吉姆诺佩蒂》改编为高音萨克斯与弦乐版本。
zh-CN.note: 陶土把飞鹤带到弯曲的表面。萨蒂的作品在这里由高音萨克斯与弦乐承载，也经历了一次材料转换。这样的搭配让鸟仍在飞，瓶子仍静静站着。

title: The Pink That Remains
originalTitle: Roses × Danseuses de Delphes

facts.text: The Met dates Roses to 1890 and notes that its pink pigments have faded over time.
Patrizia Prati performs Debussy’s piano prelude Danseuses de Delphes in this recording.

note: The roses have changed while the painting has remained. Their faded pink makes Danseuses de Delphes feel like an apt companion in title: both bring an earlier presence into a room where someone is looking now.

zh-CN.title: 留下的粉色
facts: 大都会将《玫瑰》定年为1890年，并指出粉红颜料随时间褪色。
Patrizia Prati在这份录音中演奏德彪西钢琴前奏曲《德尔斐的舞女》。
zh-CN.note: 画留了下来，玫瑰却已经变了颜色。褪去的粉红，让《德尔斐的舞女》这个题名成为合适的陪伴：两者都把从前的存在带进此刻有人观看的房间。

title: A Jar for Water
originalTitle: Water Jar (Olla) with Rainbird × Gymnopédie No. 1

facts.text: This Zuni (A:shiwi) ceramic olla dates to 1850–60. Such jars were used to collect, carry, and store water.
This recording of Satie’s Gymnopédie No. 1 is credited to Teknopazzo, with file repair by Mitar, and released under CC0.

note: The jar’s rounded body and the Rainbird’s curling beak return water to an ordinary household scale. I chose a solo-piano Gymnopédie to keep company with the vessel as a whole, before looking closely at its painted marks.

zh-CN.title: 盛水的罐
facts: 这件祖尼（A:shiwi）陶制水罐定年为1850—1860年；同类器物用于取水、运水和储水。
这份萨蒂《第一号吉姆诺佩蒂》录音署名Teknopazzo，文件修复者为Mitar，以CC0发布。
zh-CN.note: 圆鼓的罐身和雨鸟弯曲的喙，把水带回日常生活的尺度。这里选择钢琴独奏《第一号吉姆诺佩蒂》，先与整件器物共处，再走近那些绘画痕迹。

title: A Mountain in White
originalTitle: Flowers of a Hundred Worlds (Momoyogusa): Mount Fuji (Fuji) × Cylinder One

facts.text: Kamisaka Sekka’s Mount Fuji belongs to Momoyogusa, dated 1909–10; the museum lists color woodcuts with gold and silver.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder One, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: A whole mountain becomes one broad white shape. Cylinder One begins this small sequence of pictures paired with Zabriskie’s numbered works: a chance to stay with a single outline for the length of one piece.

zh-CN.title: 白色的山
facts: 神坂雪佳的《富士》属于1909—1910年的《百々世草》；馆方登记媒材为使用金银的彩色木版画。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder One，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 整座山变成一大片白色形状。Cylinder One开启这组与Zabriskie编号作品相伴的小序列：用一首曲子的时间，留在一个轮廓旁。

title: The Partly Hidden Heron
originalTitle: Flowers of a Hundred Worlds (Momoyogusa): White Heron (Shirosagi) × Gnossienne No. 2

facts.text: Kamisaka Sekka’s White Heron comes from Momoyogusa, dated 1909–10.
La Pianista performs Satie’s Gnossienne No. 2 on piano in this recording.

note: The heron is partly hidden, and that is what makes me want to keep looking. I chose a short Satie piano piece for this small encounter: the bird can remain behind the foreground while the whole image stays open.

zh-CN.title: 未露全貌的白鹭
facts: 神坂雪佳《白鹭》出自1909—1910年的《百々世草》。
La Pianista在这份录音中以钢琴演奏萨蒂《第二号玄秘曲》。
zh-CN.note: 白鹭被遮住了一部分，这恰好让人愿意继续看。这里选一首短小的萨蒂钢琴曲，留给这次小小的相遇：鸟仍在前景后面，整幅图仍有余地。

title: Below the Pines
originalTitle: Howling Wolf in a Deep Mountain Valley × Stories About the World That Once Was

facts.text: Yoshimura Hōryū painted this wolf in 1912, using ink and color on silk.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Stories About the World That Once Was, released on Music from Neptune Flux (2016).

note: The wolf occupies only a little of the forest. Stories About the World That Once Was gives this 1912 painting a second fictional horizon, borrowed from a game soundtrack. Its title turns the clearing into a place one might remember.

zh-CN.title: 松下
facts: 吉村凤柳于1912年绘制这只狼，媒材为绢本水墨设色。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Stories About the World That Once Was，收录于2016年的《Music from Neptune Flux》。
zh-CN.note: 狼只占森林里很小的一块地方。Stories About the World That Once Was借游戏配乐的标题，给这幅1912年的画添了一层虚构远景：林间空地也像一个会被记起的地方。

title: A Hoopoe on Citrus
originalTitle: Hoopoe on a Citrus Tree Branch × Deuxième Arabesque

facts.text: This painting is catalogued as Company-school work from Calcutta, around 1800, in color on paper.
Debussy’s Arabesque No. 2 is performed on piano by Patrizia Prati in this recording.

note: The hoopoe’s crest, wing stripes and claws repay different kinds of attention. The name Arabesque offers a link to that precise ornament. I chose the second piece so this bird has its own musical partner, separate from the wheat field.

zh-CN.title: 柑橘枝上的戴胜
facts: 馆方将这件纸本设色作品归入约1800年的加尔各答公司画派。
这份录音由Patrizia Prati以钢琴演奏德彪西《第二号阿拉伯风格曲》。
zh-CN.note: 戴胜的羽冠、翅膀条纹和爪子，各有值得细看的地方。Arabesque这个名字与精密的装饰形成联系。选第二首，是让这只鸟拥有区别于麦田的音乐伙伴。

title: Turns in Raffia
originalTitle: Embroidered Raffia Pile Cloth × Cylinder Four

facts.text: This 20th-century embroidered pile cloth is attributed to Kuba peoples in the Democratic Republic of Congo; its materials are raffia and dye.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder Four, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: The cloth offers a path, then another turning. Cylinder Four belongs here as part of a numbered listening sequence: return to the same corner after the piece and see whether a different route through the raffia catches your eye.

zh-CN.title: 拉菲草的转折
facts: 这件20世纪绒绣织物归于刚果民主共和国库巴人，材料为拉菲草及染料。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder Four，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 织物给出一条路，接着又有一个转折。Cylinder Four作为编号聆听序列的一部分放在这里：曲子结束后再看同一个角落，也许会注意到穿过拉菲草的另一条路线。

title: Two Directions of Thread
originalTitle: Ceremonial Cloth × Cylinder Seven

facts.text: This early-20th-century ceremonial cloth from Bali is cotton, made in double ikat and tabby weave.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder Seven, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: In double ikat, the two directions of thread have to meet. I paired this long cloth with Cylinder Seven to give its proportions a whole piece of time. The fringe is as much a destination as the patterned center.

zh-CN.title: 经与纬
facts: 这件巴厘岛20世纪初礼仪织物为棉质，以双重伊卡特及平纹组织制成。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder Seven，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 双重伊卡特需要两个方向的线相遇。将这幅长织物与Cylinder Seven放在一起，是想给它的比例一整首曲子的时间。流苏和中央纹样一样，值得成为目光的终点。

title: Light Printed on Paper
originalTitle: Camera Work: Poplars and Clouds × Heliograph

facts.text: The museum dates this Hans Watzek photogravure from Camera Work to 1906.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Heliograph, released on Divider (2011).

note: Heliograph puts light into its title; this photogravure puts a photograph into ink and paper. Their meeting draws attention to the image as an object: the poplar reaches upward through a surface someone printed and bound.

zh-CN.title: 印在纸上的光
facts: 馆方将这件Hans Watzek作品的《Camera Work》照相凹版印刷品定年为1906年。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Heliograph，收录于2011年的《Divider》。
zh-CN.note: Heliograph的题名带着光，这件照相凹版印刷品则把照片变成墨与纸。两者相遇，让图像作为物件显现：杨树向上生长，穿过一张曾被印刷、装订的纸。

title: Looking West from Kanab Wash
originalTitle: Grand Cañon, Colorado River, Mouth of Kanab Wash, Looking West × A New Day In a New Sector

facts.text: William H. Bell made this 1872 photograph for the survey west of the 100th meridian; the museum identifies an albumen print from a tannin dry-plate negative.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed A New Day In a New Sector, released on Music from Neptune Flux (2016).

note: A New Day In a New Sector sets a game-world title beside an expedition photograph. Both invite the eye onward, but the dated mount gives this view a particular history. The canyon is also a record of someone’s position.

zh-CN.title: 从卡纳布河口向西
facts: William H. Bell于1872年为西经100度以西测绘拍摄此图；馆方登记为由单宁干版底片制作的蛋白相纸照片。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏A New Day In a New Sector，收录于2016年的《Music from Neptune Flux》。
zh-CN.note: A New Day In a New Sector把游戏世界的题名放在考察照片旁。两者都让视线想往前走，标明年代的装裱却让眼前景象拥有具体历史。峡谷影像也记录着一个人的位置。

title: Crossing the Yamuna
originalTitle: Krishna Ferrying Radha Across the Yamuna River (recto) × Raga Kaushi Kanra

facts.text: This Kalighat painting from Kolkata dates to about 1890 and depicts Krishna ferrying Radha across the Yamuna.
Ranjit Makkuni performs Raga Kaushi Kanra on sitar, with Akram Khan on tabla, in this recording.

note: The crossing gives Radha and Krishna a small, shared stage. I chose the named sitar-and-tabla performance to make a second meeting beside it: two credited musicians accompanying a scene about the distance between people.

zh-CN.title: 渡过亚穆纳河
facts: 这幅约1890年的加尔各答卡利加特绘画描绘克里希纳载拉妲渡过亚穆纳河。
这份Raga Kaushi Kanra录音由Ranjit Makkuni演奏西塔琴，Akram Khan演奏塔布拉鼓。
zh-CN.note: 渡河给拉妲和克里希纳一座小小的共同舞台。选择这份有明确演奏者的西塔琴与塔布拉鼓录音，是想在画旁放上另一种相遇：两位音乐家陪着一幅有关人与人距离的画。

title: A Garden on the Other Side
originalTitle: Flowering Marigold (verso) × Oxygen Garden

facts.text: Flowering Marigold is the reverse of a Mughal album leaf, about 1765, in the style of Hunhar II.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Oxygen Garden, released on Divider (2011).

note: A single marigold fills its own bordered garden. Oxygen Garden gives that small enclosure a contemporary name. It also makes me think about the page as a room with two sides: another scene waits when the leaf is turned.

zh-CN.title: 纸的另一面
facts: 《盛开的万寿菊》位于约1765年的莫卧儿册页背面，馆方标注为Hunhar II风格。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Oxygen Garden，收录于2011年的《Divider》。
zh-CN.note: 一株万寿菊填满了自己有边框的花园。Oxygen Garden给这处小围合添上一个当代名字，也让册页像一间有两面的房间：翻过去，还有另一幅场景等着。

title: Kagurazaka After Rain
originalTitle: 東京拾二題　神樂坂通雨後の夜 × Candlepower

facts.text: Yoshida Hiroshi’s woodblock print is catalogued as after 1929 and belongs to Twelve Scenes of Tokyo.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Candlepower, released on Divider (2011).

note: The wet street gives each light somewhere else to appear. Candlepower is chosen for that small measure of illumination: a shop, a window, a patch of pavement. The city becomes a succession of places someone might stop.

zh-CN.title: 神乐坂雨后
facts: 馆方将吉田博这幅木版画定年为1929年以后，属于《东京拾二题》。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Candlepower，收录于2011年的《Divider》。
zh-CN.note: 湿街面让每一盏灯都有另一个显现的位置。选择Candlepower，是为了这种小尺度的照明：一家店、一扇窗、一块路面。城市变成一连串有人可能停留的地方。

title: Bird Above, Fish Below
originalTitle: Birds and Fish Mola Panels (Pair) × Cylinder Eight

facts.text: These 20th-century Guna mola panels from Panamá combine cotton reverse appliqué, appliqué, and embroidery; they originally formed parts of blouses.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder Eight, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: The bird and fish return across a pair of panels, with small decisions held inside their near-repetition. Cylinder Eight closes the numbered thread running through this collection. It is a place to compare what repeats with what the eye remembers.

zh-CN.title: 上方的鸟，下方的鱼
facts: 这对巴拿马古纳人20世纪mola织片结合棉布反向贴布、贴布与刺绣，原本是上衣的一部分。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder Eight，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 鸟和鱼在成对织片上再次出现，近似重复中藏着细小选择。Cylinder Eight收束这套编选里的编号线索，也留出一个位置，比较重复出现的东西与眼睛记住的东西。

title: Many Motifs, One Cloth
originalTitle: Wrapper (Lamba Akotifahana) × The Oceans Continue to Rise

facts.text: This silk lamba akotifahana is catalogued to the 1800s, Merina Kingdom, Madagascar; added weft threads create its motifs.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed The Oceans Continue to Rise, released on Music from Neptune Flux (2016).

note: Extra threads make room for more motifs. I chose The Oceans Continue to Rise for the contrast between its enormous title and the scale of this woven surface. A whole world can be suggested beside something that once wrapped a body.

zh-CN.title: 许多纹样，一幅织物
facts: 这件丝质lamba akotifahana定年为19世纪马达加斯加梅里纳王国，纹样以附加纬线织出。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏The Oceans Continue to Rise，收录于2016年的《Music from Neptune Flux》。
zh-CN.note: 附加的线给更多纹样腾出位置。选择The Oceans Continue to Rise，是看中宏大题名与这块织物尺度的对照：曾经包裹身体的东西旁，也可以浮现整个世界。

title: After the Rain
originalTitle: 東京拾二題　神樂坂通雨後の夜 × Late Night Radio

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Twelve Scenes of Tokyo: Kagurazaka Street after a Night Rain with the date after 1929.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Late Night Radio with an upload date of 2021-03-25 and the instrumentation Electric Piano, Bass, Drums, Synth.

note: An ordinary street can hold the end of a day. Late Night Radio gives this Tokyo view a second, present-day address: the desk where a small light is still on.

zh-CN.title: 雨停之后
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Twelve Scenes of Tokyo: Kagurazaka Street after a Night Rain》的年代标为1929年以后。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Late Night Radio》的上传日期列为2021-03-25，配器列为电钢琴、贝斯、鼓、合成器。
zh-CN.note: 一条平常的街道，也能容纳一天的尾声。《Late Night Radio》为这幅东京街景添了一个今天的地址：还亮着小灯的书桌。

title: Winter, in Print
originalTitle: Camera Work: Landscape - Winter × Late Night Radio

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Camera Work: Landscape - Winter with the date 1908.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Late Night Radio with an upload date of 2021-03-25 and the instrumentation Electric Piano, Bass, Drums, Synth.

note: A winter landscape appears on a page of Camera Work. Electric piano, bass, drums and synths place a small contemporary ensemble beside that printed photograph. I would leave this open like a magazine beside the desk.

zh-CN.title: 纸上的冬天
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Camera Work: Landscape - Winter》的年代标为1908年。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Late Night Radio》的上传日期列为2021-03-25，配器列为电钢琴、贝斯、鼓、合成器。
zh-CN.note: 冬景印在《Camera Work》的一页上，旁边配的是电钢琴、贝斯、鼓与合成器。我想让它像一本摊在桌边的杂志，偶尔抬眼还能接着看。

title: Page 131
originalTitle: Frédéric Mistral: Mémoires et Recits by Frédéric Mistral: buildings and trees (page 131) × Late Night Radio

facts.text: Auguste Brouet made this 1937 etching for page 131 of Frédéric Mistral’s Mémoires et Recits.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Late Night Radio with an upload date of 2021-03-25 and the instrumentation Electric Piano, Bass, Drums, Synth.

note: Buildings and trees occupy a page inside someone else's memoir. I like this beside Late Night Radio: two modest frames for a life that continues beyond what we can see.

zh-CN.title: 第131页

facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Flowers of a Hundred Worlds (Momoyogusa): Mount Fuji (Fuji)》的年代标为1909–10年。

zh-CN.title: 方形里的两只鸟
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Square Segmentum with Two Birds》的年代标为五至六世纪。

title: At the Garden Entrance

zh-CN.title: 花园入口

title: Hemlocks by the Railway

zh-CN.title: 铁路边的铁杉林

zh-CN.title: 穿在身上的丝

zh-CN.title: 一个字题：竹

title: A Creeper in the Garden
originalTitle: A Creeper in the Peradeniya Gardens, Ceylon × Gnossienne No. 2

facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Ceremonial Cloth》的年代标为二十世纪初。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Limit 70》的上传日期列为2019-12-18，配器列为电钢琴、合成器、打击乐。
zh-CN.note: 双面絣先处理经线与纬线，再让它们在织造中相遇。《Limit 70》的构思与特定车速下掠过的道路标线有关。两边都让人留意对齐：各自分开的部分，怎样按次序遇在一起。

title: A Cloth from Fiji
originalTitle: Tapa Cloth × Deuxième Arabesque

facts.text: This Fijian tapa cloth is made from mulberry bark; the museum dates it to before 1971.
Debussy’s Arabesque No. 2 is performed on piano by Patrizia Prati in this recording.

note: The museum associates this tapa cloth with Fiji. Patrizia Prati's piano recording gives the textile a deliberately personal musical neighbour, making this an encounter between two particular works across different histories.

zh-CN.title: 斐济的布
facts: 这件斐济塔帕布以构树皮制成，馆方将年代标为1971年以前。
这份录音由Patrizia Prati以钢琴演奏德彪西《第二号阿拉伯风格曲》。
zh-CN.note: 馆方将这件塔帕布归于斐济。Patrizia Prati的钢琴录音，为织物带来一位具体的音乐邻居，两件作品也就带着各自的历史在此相遇。

title: Bamboo in Moonlight
originalTitle: 월하묵죽도 [月下墨竹圖] × 流水

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Bamboo in Moonlight with the date 1500s.
Charlie Huang recorded the Sichuan-style guqin piece Liu Shui in Birmingham on 15 April 2006.

note: Moonlight changes the occasion for looking at bamboo. I chose Charlie Huang's guqin recording of Flowing Water so that the pairing holds two natural subjects, one pictured and one named by a musical work.

zh-CN.title: 月下竹
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Bamboo in Moonlight》的年代标为十六世纪。
Charlie Huang于2006年4月15日在伯明翰录制这首川派古琴曲《流水》。
zh-CN.note: 月光改变了看竹的时刻。选黄查理的古琴《流水》录音，让这一组容下两种自然题材：一种由画呈现，一种留在乐曲的名字里。

title: Watching Fish
originalTitle: Album of Landscape Paintings Illustrating Old Poems: Scholar watching Fish × 陽關三疊

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Album of Landscape Paintings Illustrating Old Poems: Scholar watching Fish with the date 1745.
This recording of Yangguan Sandie is performed on guqin by Charlie Huang (Charles R Tsua).

note: A scholar watching fish gives attention a visible subject. Beside Charlie Huang's guqin recording of Yangguan Sandie, the scene becomes company for a study break spent watching rather than collecting another fact.

zh-CN.title: 看鱼
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Album of Landscape Paintings Illustrating Old Poems: Scholar watching Fish》的年代标为1745年。
这份《阳关三叠》录音由Charlie Huang（Charles R Tsua）以古琴演奏。
zh-CN.note: 文人看鱼，让专注有了一个看得见的对象。配上黄查理的古琴《阳关三叠》，这幅画也成了读书间隙的陪伴，看一会儿就很满足。

title: Watching Rain Clouds
originalTitle: Royal lovers watching rain clouds: The month of Bhadon, from a Barahmasa × Raga Kaushi Kanra

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Royal lovers watching rain clouds: The month of Bhadon, from a Barahmasa with the date c. 1790.
Ranjit Makkuni performs Raga Kaushi Kanra on sitar, with Akram Khan on tabla, in this recording.

note: The painting belongs to a sequence of months, making weather a measure of time. Ranjit Makkuni's sitar with Akram Khan's tabla brings another sustained practice beside that seasonal attention.

zh-CN.title: 看雨云
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Royal lovers watching rain clouds: The month of Bhadon, from a Barahmasa》的年代标为约1790年。
这份Raga Kaushi Kanra录音由Ranjit Makkuni演奏西塔琴，Akram Khan演奏塔布拉鼓。
zh-CN.note: 这幅画属于描绘月份的组画，以天气感知时间。Ranjit Makkuni的西塔琴与Akram Khan的塔布拉鼓，在这份对季节的留意旁，带来另一种长时间的练习。

title: Deer, Phoenix, Lotus
originalTitle: Ceramic dish with deer, phoenix, and lotus blossoms × Recuerdos de la Alhambra

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Ceramic dish with deer, phoenix, and lotus blossoms with the date 1300–1350.
Carlo Alberto Boni performs Francisco Tárrega’s Recuerdos de la Alhambra on guitar in this recording.

note: A dish gathers several living forms into one usable object. Carlo Alberto Boni's guitar recording keeps the musical side at the scale of one named performer, a close companion to this small painted world.

zh-CN.title: 鹿、凤凰与莲花
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Ceramic dish with deer, phoenix, and lotus blossoms》的年代标为1300–1350年。
这份录音由Carlo Alberto Boni以吉他演奏弗朗西斯科·塔雷加《阿尔罕布拉宫的回忆》。
zh-CN.note: 一只盘子把几种生灵收进日用器物。Carlo Alberto Boni的吉他录音，让音乐这一边也保持在一位具体演奏者的尺度，陪着这个小小的彩绘世界。

title: Wisteria on a Page
originalTitle: Flowers of a Hundred Worlds (Momoyogusa): Wisteria (Fuji) × Première Arabesque

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Flowers of a Hundred Worlds (Momoyogusa): Wisteria (Fuji) with the date 1909–10.
Debussy’s Arabesque No. 1 is performed on piano by Patrizia Prati in this recording.

note: A flowering plant becomes a design that can be revisited on the page. Patrizia Prati's recording of Debussy's first Arabesque brings another worked arrangement beside it: a piano score given a particular performance.

zh-CN.title: 纸上的紫藤
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Flowers of a Hundred Worlds (Momoyogusa): Wisteria (Fuji)》的年代标为1909–10年。
这份录音由Patrizia Prati以钢琴演奏德彪西《第一号阿拉伯风格曲》。
zh-CN.note: 开花的植物变成纸上可以反复看的设计。Patrizia Prati演奏的德彪西《第一号阿拉伯风格曲》，在旁边带来另一种安排：乐谱成为一次具体的演奏。

title: Orchid Blossoms
originalTitle: Orchid Blossoms × Deuxième Arabesque

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Orchid Blossoms with the date 1873.
Debussy’s Arabesque No. 2 is performed on piano by Patrizia Prati in this recording.

note: Heade's orchid paintings grew out of travels in Central and South America. I put this canvas beside Patrizia Prati's solo-piano Debussy to bring the scale back to a room: a journey kept in paint, with one instrument for company.

zh-CN.title: 兰花
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Orchid Blossoms》的年代标为1873年。
这份录音由Patrizia Prati以钢琴演奏德彪西《第二号阿拉伯风格曲》。
zh-CN.note: 海德的兰花题材与他在中南美洲的旅行有关。我让这幅油画与Patrizia Prati的德彪西钢琴独奏相伴，把尺度带回房间：一次旅行留在画里，一件乐器陪在身旁。

title: A River on a Bottle
originalTitle: 백자 청화 산수무늬 사각병 [白磁靑畫山水文四角甁] × Gnossienne No. 2

facts.text: This nineteenth-century Korean blue-and-white porcelain bottle depicts the Han River. Its separate facets were assembled before firing.
La Pianista performs Satie’s Gnossienne No. 2 on piano in this recording.

note: The Han River appears on a square-shaped bottle, turning a landscape into something that can sit on a shelf. La Pianista's solo-piano Satie gives this compact view a companion at the desk.

zh-CN.title: 瓶上的江景
facts: 这件十九世纪韩国青花瓷瓶描绘汉江景色；各面分别制作后，在入窑烧制前组装起来。
La Pianista在这份录音中以钢琴演奏萨蒂《第二号玄秘曲》。
zh-CN.note: 汉江风景出现在方形瓶上，山水成了可以摆在架上的东西。La Pianista的萨蒂钢琴独奏，陪着这处小景来到书桌边。

title: Returning to the Heron
originalTitle: Flowers of a Hundred Worlds (Momoyogusa): White Heron (Shirosagi) × Gymnopédie No. 1

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Flowers of a Hundred Worlds (Momoyogusa): White Heron (Shirosagi) with the date 1909–10.
This recording of Satie’s Gymnopédie No. 1 is credited to Teknopazzo, with file repair by Mitar, and released under CC0.

note: A familiar print can deserve another visit. Teknopazzo's recording of the first Gymnopédie changes the musical company for Sekka's heron, making a small return possible during an ordinary workday.

zh-CN.title: 再看白鹭
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Flowers of a Hundred Worlds (Momoyogusa): White Heron (Shirosagi)》的年代标为1909–10年。
这份萨蒂《第一号吉姆诺佩蒂》录音署名Teknopazzo，文件修复者为Mitar，以CC0发布。
zh-CN.note: 熟悉的版画，也值得再看一次。Teknopazzo录制的《第一号吉姆诺佩蒂》为雪佳的白鹭换了音乐陪伴，让平常的工作日里也有一次小小重访。

title: Synthwave Radio
originalTitle: synthwave radio 🌌 beats to chill/game to

facts.text: Lofi Girl publishes this synthwave broadcast and credits its artwork to Lofi Studio.

note: The animated room and synthesizers belong to the same broadcast. Keeping them together lets a contemporary drawn world occupy the room without adding a second visual story.

title: Anjunadeep Radio
originalTitle: Anjunadeep Radio • Live 24/7 • Best of Deep House, Chill, House, Progressive • Work From Home

facts.text: Anjunadeep labels this live broadcast with deep house, chill, house and progressive music in its title.

note: A more rhythm-led choice for times when a quiet piano feels too still. Tracks change within the broadcast; individual songs and vocals depend on the station.

title: Chillhop Essentials
originalTitle: Essentials Radio - chill beats to enjoy Fall to 🍁

facts.text: Chillhop Music publishes Essentials Radio. The currently verified broadcast is titled for the fall season.

note: This selection keeps the station’s illustrated scene with the music curated for it. The illustration can stay familiar while the tracks change underneath it.

title: Claude FM
originalTitle: Claude FM 🎵 music for thinking and building

facts.text: This broadcast is published on the Claude YouTube channel under the title “Claude FM — music for thinking and building”.

note: Keep the broadcast's own changing scene and music together. Its current track comes from the station, so FM does not attach a fixed composer or work title to it.

title: Glaciers near the Strait of Magellan
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Cylinder Seven

facts.text: Earth Observation taken during a day pass by the Expedition 40 crew aboard the International Space Station (ISS). Folder lists this as: Near the Straits of Magellan - Glaciers.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder Seven, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: The broken white of the glaciers calls for a long ambient span rather than another sharply drawn line.

zh-CN.title: 麦哲伦海峡附近的冰川
facts: 档案文件夹标注为麦哲伦海峡附近的冰川。 NASA档案日期：2014-06-01；摄影：Reid Wiseman。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder Seven，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 冰川的白色被云切开；配一段铺开的氛围，让碎片有地方连起来。

title: At the edge of the Namib
originalTitle: Earth Observations taken by Expedition 47 Crewmember. × That Zen Moment

facts.text: ISS047e022280 (03/26/2016) --- This interesting Earth observation image from the International Space Station seems an abstract painting but is really the outskirts of the Namib Desert in southwest Africa. One of the oldest and largest deserts in the world, the Namib stretches inland from the Atlantic Ocean, covering large swathes of Namibia and parts of Angola and South Africa. This arid hotspot surprisingly supports a diverse number of plants and animals, some of which are found nowhere else in the world.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists That Zen Moment with an upload date of 2024-04-14 and the instrumentation Strings, Bowl Drum.

note: A bowl-drum-and-strings palette sits beside the dune folds without turning this aerial view into a desert adventure.

zh-CN.title: 纳米布沙漠边缘
facts: NASA将这里识别为非洲西南部纳米布沙漠的边缘。 NASA档案日期：2016-03-26；摄影：Jeff Williams。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《That Zen Moment》的上传日期列为2024-04-14，配器列为弦乐、碗鼓。
zh-CN.note: 沙丘像折起的纸；弦乐与钵鼓放在旁边，不把这张俯瞰照配成沙漠冒险。

title: Salar de Uyuni
originalTitle: Earth observation taken by the Expedition 43 crew × Cylinder Four

facts.text: ISS043E184521 (05/10/2015) --- NASA astronaut Terry Virts Expedition 43 Commander on the International Space Station tweeted this Earth observation image of South America with the following comment: "Salar de Uyuni in the #Bolivia desert #SouthAmerica. The world's largest salt flat".
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder Four, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: The salt flat is a pale interruption in a darker field; a small ambient piece leaves that interruption intact.

zh-CN.title: 乌尤尼盐沼
facts: NASA的原始说明引用宇航员的说明，将这里标为玻利维亚乌尤尼盐沼。 NASA档案日期：2015-05-10；摄影：Terry Virts。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder Four，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 盐地在深色地表中空出一块；短小的氛围段落把这处空白留住。

title: Southern islands
originalTitle: Earth Observations taken by the Expedition 39 Crew × Gymnopédie No. 1

facts.text: Earth observation taken by the Expedition 39 crew aboard the ISS. Image was released by astronaut on Twitter and downlinked in folder: south islands.
This recording of Satie’s Gymnopédie No. 1 is credited to Teknopazzo, with file repair by Mitar, and released under CC0.

note: A few islands, a great deal of blue: Satie gives the sparse composition a human-sized pace.

zh-CN.title: 南方岛屿
facts: 原始档案将这幅影像归入“south islands”文件夹，未给出更确切地名。 NASA档案日期：2014-03-30；摄影：Rick Mastracchio。
这份萨蒂《第一号吉姆诺佩蒂》录音署名Teknopazzo，文件修复者为Mitar，以CC0发布。
zh-CN.note: 岛屿很少，蓝色很多；萨蒂给这个疏朗的构图一个人的步速。

title: The Bahamas from orbit
originalTitle: Earth Observation × The Oceans Continue to Rise

facts.text: ISS047e069406 (04/20/2016) ---Earth observation image taken by the Expedition 47 crew aboard the International Space Station. This is an oblique south-looking view of the main Bahama island chain.  Cuba is across the entire top of the image, the Florida Peninsula on the right margin. In the Bahamas, the main Andros island is just distinguishable under cloud upper left of center.  Under less cloud is the Abaco Islands in the foreground (middle of pic nearest camera left of center.)
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed The Oceans Continue to Rise, released on Music from Neptune Flux (2016).

note: I borrow an underwater game's score for the shallows seen from above; the two viewpoints meet at the water.

zh-CN.title: 从轨道俯瞰巴哈马
facts: NASA说明这是朝南斜望巴哈马主岛链的视角，画面上方可见古巴。 NASA档案日期：2016-04-20；摄影：Jeff Williams。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏The Oceans Continue to Rise，收录于2016年的《Music from Neptune Flux》。
zh-CN.note: 借一段水下游戏配乐，陪从上方看见的浅海；两个视角在水面相遇。

title: Artificial islands from orbit
originalTitle: Earth Observations taken by Expedtion 38 crewmember × Cylinder One

facts.text: Earth Observations taken by Expedition 38 crewmember.  Crewmember indicates Middle East man-made Islands.  Image was released by astronaut on Twitter.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder One, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: The engineered coastline has almost diagrammatic edges; ambient music lets the photograph stay a view, not a plan.

zh-CN.title: 从轨道俯瞰人工岛
facts: 档案引用机组成员的说明，将这里称为中东的人工岛。 NASA档案日期：2013-11-12；摄影：Rick Mastracchio。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder One，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 人工海岸的边缘近似图纸；放上氛围音乐，让它仍是一眼风景。

title: Coast and river from orbit
originalTitle: Earth Observation × 流水

facts.text: Earth Observation taken during a day pass by the Expedition 40 crew aboard the International Space Station (ISS).   Folder lists this as: Chappaquiddick Island also Niagra Falls Hudson etc.
Charlie Huang recorded the Sichuan-style guqin piece Liu Shui in Birmingham on 15 April 2006.

note: Water branches between settled ground; guqin makes a useful companion to following those bends.

zh-CN.title: 从轨道俯瞰海岸与河流
facts: 档案文件夹列出数处地点，不能据此唯一确认本帧位置。 NASA档案日期：2014-07-05；摄影：Reid Wiseman。
Charlie Huang于2006年4月15日在伯明翰录制这首川派古琴曲《流水》。
zh-CN.note: 水在有人居住的地表间分岔；古琴适合陪目光沿着这些转弯走。

title: Islands and a visiting spacecraft
originalTitle: Earth Observations taken by the Expedition 39 Crew × A New Day In a New Sector

facts.text: Earth observation taken by the Expedition 39 crew aboard the ISS. A portion of the docked Soyuz TMA-11M spacecraft is in view. Image was released by astronaut on Instagram and downlinked in folder: Personal photos and the Maldive islands.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed A New Day In a New Sector, released on Music from Neptune Flux (2016).

note: The spacecraft at the edge supplies the scale. A game score leaves room for the journey without inventing a mission.

zh-CN.title: 岛屿与来访的飞船
facts: NASA说明画面中可见对接的联盟TMA-11M飞船的一部分。 NASA档案日期：2014-04-10；摄影：Steve Swanson。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏A New Day In a New Sector，收录于2016年的《Music from Neptune Flux》。
zh-CN.note: 边缘的飞船给出尺度；游戏配乐添一点远行感，不替照片编造任务。

title: The Galápagos Islands
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Oxygen Garden

facts.text: Earth observation taken during day pass by an Expedition 36 crew member on board the International Space Station (ISS). Per Twitter message: The Galápagos Islands.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Oxygen Garden, released on Divider (2011).

note: Clouds interrupt the island shapes. Oxygen Garden is chosen as a garden-like association, not a description of this ecosystem.

zh-CN.title: 加拉帕戈斯群岛
facts: 档案引用宇航员发布的文字，将这里识别为加拉帕戈斯群岛。 NASA档案日期：2013-08-13；摄影：Karen Nyberg。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Oxygen Garden，收录于2011年的《Divider》。
zh-CN.note: 云把岛的形状遮断；《Oxygen Garden》带来花园的联想，不替这里的生态作说明。

title: Sunset over Kazakhstan
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Heliograph

facts.text: Earth Observation taken during a day pass by the Expedition 40 crew aboard the International Space Station (ISS). Folder lists this as: Sunsetting over the mountains of Kazakhstan.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Heliograph, released on Divider (2011).

note: The narrowing light at the horizon is why I chose Heliograph: a correspondence of titles and light, not an astronomical claim.

zh-CN.title: 哈萨克斯坦上空的日落
facts: 原始档案文件夹将这里标为哈萨克斯坦山地上空的日落。 NASA档案日期：2014-06-26；摄影：Reid Wiseman。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Heliograph，收录于2011年的《Divider》。
zh-CN.note: 地平线的光渐渐收窄，所以选《Heliograph》；这是光与曲名的联想。

title: Clouds over the Caspian Sea
originalTitle: Earth Observation taken during the Expedition 37 mission × Cylinder Eight

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a day pass by the Expedition 37 crew. Per Twitter message: intersecting clouds over the Caspian Sea & Caucasus Mountains.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder Eight, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: Cloud bands and mountain ridges overlap; an ambient layer avoids choosing which line the eye must follow.

zh-CN.title: 里海上空的云
facts: 档案引用的宇航员文字提到里海与高加索山脉上空交错的云。 NASA档案日期：2013-10-17；摄影：Karen Nyberg。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder Eight，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 云带与山脊叠在一起；氛围层不替眼睛决定该沿哪一道线看。

title: A mountain passage
originalTitle: Earth Observation taken during the Expedition 37 mission × Danseuses de Delphes

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a day pass by the Expedition 37 crew.  Possibly identified as Dzungarian Gate, mountain pass between China and Kazakhstan.
Patrizia Prati performs Debussy’s piano prelude Danseuses de Delphes in this recording.

note: The passage between dark slopes feels architectural. Debussy's piano offers a measured way through it.

zh-CN.title: 山间通道
facts: NASA档案认为这里可能是中国与哈萨克斯坦之间的准噶尔门，识别仍有不确定性。 NASA档案日期：2013-10-21；摄影：Karen Nyberg。
Patrizia Prati在这份录音中演奏德彪西钢琴前奏曲《德尔斐的舞女》。
zh-CN.note: 深色山坡间的通道有建筑般的形状；德彪西的钢琴给它从容的步幅。

title: Brukkaros Mountain
originalTitle: Earth Observations taken by Expedition 47 Crewmember. × That Zen Moment

facts.text: ISS047e022293 (03/26/2016) --- This Earth Observation image from the International Space Station  is of a large extinct volcano in the lower southwest African Brukkaros Mountain in the country of Namibia.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists That Zen Moment with an upload date of 2024-04-14 and the instrumentation Strings, Bowl Drum.

note: The isolated circular mountain gets a spare strings-and-bowl-drum setting; no triumphant summit music is needed.

zh-CN.title: 布鲁卡罗斯山
facts: NASA将这里识别为纳米比亚布鲁卡罗斯山的一座大型死火山。 NASA档案日期：2016-03-26；摄影：Jeff Williams。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《That Zen Moment》的上传日期列为2024-04-14，配器列为弦乐、碗鼓。
zh-CN.note: 独立的环形山体配疏落的弦乐与钵鼓，不必加一段登顶凯歌。

title: The Tien Shan range
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Cylinder Seven

facts.text: Earth observation taken by an Expedition 36 crew member on board the International Space Station (ISS).  Per Twitter message: Tien Shan mountain range, Central Asia.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder Seven, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: Snow and cloud are difficult to separate here; the long ambient selection permits that uncertainty.

zh-CN.title: 天山山脉
facts: 档案引用宇航员文字，将画面识别为中亚天山山脉。 NASA档案日期：2013-09-01；摄影：Karen Nyberg。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder Seven，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 这里的雪与云不容易分开；长一些的氛围段落容得下这种含混。

title: Ruvuma River
originalTitle: Earth Observation taken during the Expedition 37 mission × 流水

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a day pass by the Expedition 37 crew. Per Twitter message: Ruvuma River,  Tanzania and Mozambique.
Charlie Huang recorded the Sichuan-style guqin piece Liu Shui in Birmingham on 15 April 2006.

note: The river nearly disappears among the cloud marks; Flowing Water gives the eye a thread to recover.

zh-CN.title: 鲁伍马河
facts: 原始说明将画面标为坦桑尼亚与莫桑比克之间的鲁伍马河。 NASA档案日期：2013-10-12；摄影：Karen Nyberg。
Charlie Huang于2006年4月15日在伯明翰录制这首川派古琴曲《流水》。
zh-CN.note: 河在云点中几乎消失；《流水》给目光留一条可以重新找出的线。

title: The Mississippi River
originalTitle: Earth Observation taken during the Expedition 37 mission × Gnossienne No. 2

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a day pass by the Expedition 37 crew.  Per Twitter message: The Mississippi River through Missouri, Tennessee, Arkansas, Mississippi.
La Pianista performs Satie’s Gnossienne No. 2 on piano in this recording.

note: The river's deliberate bends meet Satie's piano; I like the contrast with the much straighter traces nearby.

zh-CN.title: 密西西比河
facts: 档案文字提到密西西比河穿过密苏里、田纳西、阿肯色和密西西比一带。 NASA档案日期：2013-09-14；摄影：Karen Nyberg。
La Pianista在这份录音中以钢琴演奏萨蒂《第二号玄秘曲》。
zh-CN.note: 河道的弯折遇上萨蒂钢琴，旁边较直的地表痕迹因此更值得看。

title: Morning fog in river valleys
originalTitle: Earth Observation taken during the Expedition 37 mission × Candlepower

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a day pass by the Expedition 37 crew.  Per Twitter message: Early morning fog in the river valleys of Ohio and West Virginia.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Candlepower, released on Divider (2011).

note: Fog draws light branches across dark ground. Candlepower is a small-light association at this enormous scale.

zh-CN.title: 河谷晨雾
facts: 档案引用宇航员文字，描述俄亥俄州和西弗吉尼亚州河谷中的晨雾。 NASA档案日期：2013-09-27；摄影：Karen Nyberg。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Candlepower，收录于2011年的《Divider》。
zh-CN.note: 雾在暗地上画出亮枝条；用《Candlepower》的小光，陪这个巨大的尺度。

title: Rivers in Brazil
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Arabesque No. 1

facts.text: Earth observation taken during day pass by an Expedition 36 crew member on board the International Space Station (ISS). Per Twitter message: Amazing rivers in Brazil.
Debussy’s Arabesque No. 1 is performed on piano by Patrizia Prati in this recording.

note: Several river lines share the frame; the Arabesque is chosen for its branching idea rather than a national association.

zh-CN.title: 巴西的河流
facts: NASA档案引用宇航员文字，将这些河流标为位于巴西。 NASA档案日期：2013-07-29；摄影：Karen Nyberg。
这份录音由Patrizia Prati以钢琴演奏德彪西《第一号阿拉伯风格曲》。
zh-CN.note: 几条河线共用一个画面；选《阿拉伯风格曲》是取枝蔓的联想，不是地域对应。

title: Sun glint from orbit
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Heliograph

facts.text: Earth Observation taken during a day pass by the Expedition 40 crew aboard the International Space Station (ISS).  Folder lists this as: Eastern half of US, sun glint, Texas, Maryland, Mississippi river, Great Lakes.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Heliograph, released on Divider (2011).

note: The sun-glint spreads across an entire curve of Earth; Heliograph keeps light, rather than travel, at the centre.

zh-CN.title: 从轨道看太阳反光
facts: 档案文件夹提到美国东部与水面的太阳反光，未唯一确认本帧地名。 NASA档案日期：2014-06-14；摄影：Reid Wiseman。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Heliograph，收录于2011年的《Divider》。
zh-CN.note: 反光越过地球的弧面；《Heliograph》让光本身成为这组的中心。

title: Libya toward the Mediterranean
originalTitle: Earth Observation taken during the Expedition 37 mission × Cylinder Four

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a day pass by the Expedition 37 crew. Per Twitter message: Southwest Libya to the Mediterranean coast.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder Four, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: The oblique view stretches the desert into a band. An ambient miniature leaves its apparent speed unresolved.

zh-CN.title: 从利比亚望向地中海
facts: 档案文字描述从利比亚西南部到地中海沿岸的视野。 NASA档案日期：2013-10-11；摄影：Karen Nyberg。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder Four，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 斜看的沙漠被拉成一条带；短小的氛围让那种速度感悬着。

title: Along the eastern coast
originalTitle: Earth Observations taken by the Expedition 39 Crew × Evening

facts.text: Earth observation taken by the Expedition 39 crew aboard the ISS. Image was released by astronaut on Instagram and downlinked in folder: Florida and up the East coast.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Evening with an upload date of 2023-08-15 and the instrumentation Guitar, Cello, Oboe.

note: Coast and inland texture share a muted frame; guitar, cello and oboe offer a warmer counterweight.

zh-CN.title: 沿着东海岸
facts: 原始文件夹标签是佛罗里达及美国东海岸一带。 NASA档案日期：2014-04-12；摄影：Steve Swanson。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Evening》的上传日期列为2023-08-15，配器列为吉他、大提琴、双簧管。
zh-CN.note: 海岸和内陆纹理都收在暗色里；吉他、大提琴与双簧管给它一点温暖的对照。

title: The southwest coast of Peru
originalTitle: Earth Observation × A New Day In a New Sector

facts.text: Earth observation taken during day pass by an Expedition 36 crew member on board the International Space Station (ISS). Per Twitter message: Southwest coast of Peru.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed A New Day In a New Sector, released on Music from Neptune Flux (2016).

note: The sharp curve against black space feels like crossing a boundary; the chosen game score belongs to that threshold.

zh-CN.title: 秘鲁西南海岸
facts: 档案引用的宇航员文字将画面标为秘鲁西南海岸。 NASA档案日期：2013-07-26；摄影：Karen Nyberg。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏A New Day In a New Sector，收录于2016年的《Music from Neptune Flux》。
zh-CN.note: 弧形地表挨着黑色太空，像一道边界；这段游戏配乐陪的是跨过去之前的一刻。

title: Somalia and the Indian Ocean
originalTitle: Earth Observation × The Oceans Continue to Rise

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a day pass by an Expedition 36 crew member on board the International Space Station (ISS).  Per Twitter message: Coast of Somalia on the Indian Ocean.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed The Oceans Continue to Rise, released on Music from Neptune Flux (2016).

note: Sea, land and the thin horizon occupy separate bands. The underwater score quietly reverses our viewing direction.

zh-CN.title: 索马里与印度洋
facts: 档案文字将画面识别为索马里濒临印度洋的海岸。 NASA档案日期：2013-09-08；摄影：Karen Nyberg。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏The Oceans Continue to Rise，收录于2016年的《Music from Neptune Flux》。
zh-CN.note: 海、陆和地平线分成几层；水下配乐悄悄把观看方向倒转。

title: The coast of Namibia
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Midnight Tale

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a day pass by an Expedition 37 crew member on board the International Space Station (ISS). Identified via Twitter message as west central coast of Namibia.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Midnight Tale with an upload date of 2019-04-05 and the instrumentation Guitar, Lute.

note: The coast has the colour of old paper; guitar and lute make this vast surface feel closer to hand.

zh-CN.title: 纳米比亚海岸
facts: NASA说明依据宇航员发布的文字将这里识别为纳米比亚中西部海岸。 NASA档案日期：2013-10-25；摄影：Karen Nyberg。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Midnight Tale》的上传日期列为2019-04-05，配器列为吉他、鲁特琴。
zh-CN.note: 海岸带着旧纸的颜色；吉他和鲁特琴把这大片地表拉近到手边。

title: West coast after dark
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Late Night Radio

facts.text: Earth Observation taken during a night pass by the Expedition 40 crew aboard the International Space Station (ISS).  File lists this as: small timelapse of US west coast at night (ISS040E010215 thru ISS040E010257).
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Late Night Radio with an upload date of 2021-03-25 and the instrumentation Electric Piano, Bass, Drums, Synth.

note: Scattered city lights suggest many separate desks still occupied; the electric-piano radio selection is their imagined company.

zh-CN.title: 入夜后的西海岸
facts: 这是NASA所列美国西海岸夜间延时序列中的一个独立画面；本批只选此序列的一帧。 NASA档案日期：2014-06-11；摄影：Reid Wiseman。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Late Night Radio》的上传日期列为2021-03-25，配器列为电钢琴、贝斯、鼓、合成器。
zh-CN.note: 零散灯光让人想到还亮着的书桌；电钢琴电台只是给这些桌边的想象作伴。

title: East coast before dawn
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Vibing Over Venus

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a night pass by the Expedition 40 crew aboard the International Space Station (ISS).  Folder lists this as: US East Coast pre-dawn. City lights.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Vibing Over Venus with an upload date of 2023-08-15 and the instrumentation Vibraphone, Bass, Drum Kit, Percussion, Strings, Piano.

note: The bright coast is almost a necklace. Vibraphone-led instrumentation offers a second set of small points.

zh-CN.title: 黎明前的东海岸
facts: 档案文件夹将画面标为美国东海岸黎明前的城市灯光。 NASA档案日期：2014-08-06；摄影：Reid Wiseman。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Vibing Over Venus》的上传日期列为2023-08-15，配器列为颤音琴、贝斯、架子鼓、打击乐、弦乐、钢琴。
zh-CN.note: 明亮海岸像一串珠；颤音琴为主的编制，给它添另一组小亮点。

title: Lights along the eastern Mediterranean
originalTitle: Earth Observation taken during the Expedition 37 mission × Study And Relax

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a night pass by the Expedition 37 crew.  City lights visible.  Per Twitter message this is eastern Mediterranean coast, Tel Aviv to Beirut.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Study And Relax with an upload date of 2020-01-08 and the instrumentation Saxophones, Piano, Bass, Percussion.

note: The illuminated shoreline is dense but legible; a restrained beat is a way of staying with that density.

zh-CN.title: 地中海东岸的灯光
facts: 档案文字将画面标为从特拉维夫到贝鲁特的地中海东岸。 NASA档案日期：2013-10-18；摄影：Karen Nyberg。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Study And Relax》的上传日期列为2020-01-08，配器列为萨克斯、钢琴、贝斯、打击乐。
zh-CN.note: 灯火密集，海岸线仍读得清；选一段克制的节拍，陪这种密度停一会儿。

title: Sunrise through an aurora
originalTitle: Aurora sequence × Floating Cities

facts.text: ISS043E155854 (04/27/2015) --- A rising sun spreads across the Earth and through the green blooming aurora to silhouette the blackened outline of the International Space Station on the morning of Apr. 27, 2015.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Floating Cities with an upload date of 2016-04-04 and the instrumentation Synths, Percussion.

note: The aurora makes a luminous edge to the frame; Floating Cities lends an electronic setting without pretending to be space sound.

zh-CN.title: 穿过极光的日出
facts: NASA说明记载，2015年4月27日的日出穿过绿色极光，空间站形成剪影。 NASA档案日期：2015-04-27；摄影：Terry Virts。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Floating Cities》的上传日期列为2016-04-04，配器列为合成器、打击乐。
zh-CN.note: 极光替画面镶了一道亮边；《Floating Cities》提供电子背景，不冒充太空里的声音。

title: Aurora and the station arm
originalTitle: Earth Observation - Aurora × Cylinder Eight

facts.text: Earth Observation taken during a night pass by the Expedition 40 crew aboard the International Space Station (ISS). Folder lists this as: Phenomenal Aurora. Part of the Space Station Remote Manipulator System (SSRMS) arm is also visible.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder Eight, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: The station arm interrupts the aurora. Ambient music allows both the machinery and the light to remain present.

zh-CN.title: 极光与空间站机械臂
facts: 档案注明极光之外，还可见空间站遥操作机械臂的一部分。 NASA档案日期：2014-08-27；摄影：Reid Wiseman。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder Eight，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 空间站机械臂挡在极光前；氛围音乐让机械和光都留在这里。

title: Earth from orbit · 2014-11-24
originalTitle: Earth Observations × Cylinder One

facts.text: Earth observation taken by the Expedition 42 crew aboard the ISS.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder One, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: Only a narrow horizon separates blue from black; a compact ambient piece respects that economy.

zh-CN.title: 从轨道看地球 · 2014-11-24
facts: 国际空间站第42远征队拍摄的地球影像。NASA档案日期为2014-11-24，摄影者为Terry Virts；原始说明未提供确切地点。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder One，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 蓝与黑之间只剩一条窄地平线；短小的氛围配合这种简省。

title: Earth from orbit · 2013-07-06
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Recuerdos de la Alhambra

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a day pass by an Expedition 36 crew member on board the International Space Station (ISS).
Carlo Alberto Boni performs Francisco Tárrega’s Recuerdos de la Alhambra on guitar in this recording.

note: Pale land folds around blue water; guitar gives the broad curves a more intimate scale.

zh-CN.title: 从轨道看地球 · 2013-07-06
facts: 国际空间站第36远征队拍摄的地球影像。NASA档案日期为2013-07-06，摄影者为Karen Nyberg；原始说明未提供确切地点。
这份录音由Carlo Alberto Boni以吉他演奏弗朗西斯科·塔雷加《阿尔罕布拉宫的回忆》。
zh-CN.note: 浅色陆地围住蓝水；吉他把宽阔的曲线缩到较亲近的尺度。

originalTitle: Earth Observation × Cylinder Seven

Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder Seven, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: A dark landmass carries a thin sprinkling of cloud. Long-form ambience lets the dark area stay unfilled.

zh-CN.title: 从轨道看地球 · 2013-07-11
facts: 国际空间站第36远征队拍摄的地球影像。NASA档案日期为2013-07-11，摄影者为Karen Nyberg；原始说明未提供确切地点。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder Seven，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 深色陆块上只有稀疏云点；长段氛围不急着把那片暗处填满。

title: Earth from orbit · 2013-06-12
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Fresh Air

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a day pass by an Expedition 36 crew member on board the International Space Station (ISS).
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Fresh Air with an upload date of 2015-12-21 and the instrumentation Piano.

note: The terrain is mottled rather than sharply divided; a piano-only selection supplies a simple foreground.

zh-CN.title: 从轨道看地球 · 2013-06-12
facts: 国际空间站第36远征队拍摄的地球影像。NASA档案日期为2013-06-12，摄影者为Karen Nyberg；原始说明未提供确切地点。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Fresh Air》的上传日期列为2015-12-21，配器列为钢琴。
zh-CN.note: 地形斑驳，没有清楚分区；只用钢琴，给眼前留一个简单的前景。

title: Earth from orbit · 2013-06-29
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Cylinder Eight

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a day pass by an Expedition 36 crew member on board the International Space Station (ISS).
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder Eight, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: The atmosphere fades gradually above the land; ambience suits an edge that cannot be traced exactly.

zh-CN.title: 从轨道看地球 · 2013-06-29
facts: 国际空间站第36远征队拍摄的地球影像。NASA档案日期为2013-06-29，摄影者为Karen Nyberg；原始说明未提供确切地点。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder Eight，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 大气在陆地上方渐渐淡去；氛围适合这道无法准确描边的边缘。

title: Earth from orbit · 2014-07-30
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Heliograph

facts.text: Earth Observation taken during a day pass by the Expedition 40 crew aboard the International Space Station (ISS).
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Heliograph, released on Divider (2011).

note: A broad wash of reflected light almost erases the surface; Heliograph leaves that brightness as the subject.

zh-CN.title: 从轨道看地球 · 2014-07-30
facts: 国际空间站第40远征队拍摄的地球影像。NASA档案日期为2014-07-30，摄影者为Reid Wiseman；原始说明未提供确切地点。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Heliograph，收录于2011年的《Divider》。
zh-CN.note: 大片反光几乎擦掉地表；《Heliograph》让亮度本身成为观看对象。

title: Earth from orbit · 2014-06-22

Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Kalimba Relaxation Music with an upload date of 2019-12-19 and the instrumentation Kalimba, Synth.

note: Cloud dots are scattered across the terrain; kalimba and synth offer a small-scale counterpart to the pattern.

zh-CN.title: 从轨道看地球 · 2014-06-22
facts: 国际空间站第40远征队拍摄的地球影像。NASA档案日期为2014-06-22，摄影者为Reid Wiseman；原始说明未提供确切地点。

zh-CN.note: 云点散落在地表上；卡林巴与合成器给这组点状纹理一个小尺度的回应。

title: Earth from orbit · 2013-07-04
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Gymnopédie No. 3

note: Clouds skim the coastline; the saxophone-and-strings Satie arrangement keeps a single melodic presence beside them.

zh-CN.title: 从轨道看地球 · 2013-07-04
facts: 国际空间站第36远征队拍摄的地球影像。NASA档案日期为2013-07-04，摄影者为Karen Nyberg；原始说明未提供确切地点。

title: Earth from orbit · 2013-06-13
originalTitle: Earth Observation × That Zen Moment

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a day pass by an Expedition 36 crew member on board the International Space Station (ISS).

note: The frame is mostly ochre ground with a pale rim; the sparse instrumental palette keeps that weight of colour.

zh-CN.title: 从轨道看地球 · 2013-06-13

zh-CN.note: 画面大半是赭色地表和浅色边沿；简省的器乐编制保留这块颜色的分量。

title: Earth from orbit · 2013-06-11
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Gnossienne No. 2

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a day pass by an Expedition 36 crew member on board the International Space Station (ISS).
La Pianista performs Satie’s Gnossienne No. 2 on piano in this recording.

note: Water divides two finely marked shores. Satie's piano is a deliberate contrast to the busy detail.

zh-CN.title: 从轨道看地球 · 2013-06-11

note: The lawn makes a broad foreground before the lake; piano leaves that uncomplicated patch of space uncomplicated.

zh-CN.title: 从茶屋眺望Claremont风景园
facts: 从Claremont风景园的茶屋越过湖面眺望。

This recording of Satie’s Gymnopédie No. 1 is credited to Teknopazzo, with file repair by Mitar, and released under CC0.

zh-CN.title: Claremont风景园：越过湖面望向露天剧场

zh-CN.note: 浅色岸在静水中加倍；萨蒂给对称一位从容、房间尺度的同伴。

zh-CN.title: 雨后城市路面的倒影

title: Street corner at night in the rain, Rio de Janeiro
